villagemaster/30505.htm.text: High Prefect Drikus: I, High Prefect Drikus, teach Orcs by the authority of Pa'agrio, the father of eternal fire. It is my duty to help ensure that we may once more attain the glory of our illustrious ancestors. You, young Orc warrior, you are like a tinderbox whose spark, though small, becomes a g…

links.text: Listen to information about first class transfer.

Q00044_HelpTheSon/30505-01.html.text: High Prefect Drikus: Oh no! The orb! It's broken! This is the orb of ancestors that Dudamara's totem told me about! It was stolen by lesser Orcs a very long time ago. Does it belong to you?

Q00044_HelpTheSon/30505-03.html.text: High Prefect Drikus: Determine the owner. He must come to me alone.

Q00044_HelpTheSon/30505-02.html.text: High Prefect Drikus: Hmm... You sound doubtful! Obviously, this is the property of the Orcs! Only we are qualified to possess it! Tell this to whoever is competing with you for it! Once its ownership is decided, come back and talk to me.

Q00044_HelpTheSon/30505-02a.html.text: High Prefect Drikus: When you decide who the owner is, send him to me.
